papers.title: Temporal Progression of Prior Precision, Surprisal, Model Updating and Tone Adaptation in Human Auditory Cortices
papers.translated_title: 人类听觉皮层中先验精度、惊奇度、模型更新与音调适应的时间进程
papers.author: van Haren, J. J. G.
papers.summary: Auditory perception emerges from the continuous integration of incoming acoustic signals with statistical predictions, a process complemented by simpler local adaptation. Yet, how all these concurrent mechanisms unfold in time remains underexplored. Using magnetoencephalography (MEG) in participants listening to stochastic tone sequences with periodically shifting inferential statistics, we modelled the temporal, spatial, and spectral dynamics of stimulus-specific repetition suppression, surprisal, model updating, and prior precision. By concurrently tracking these computational parameters within this dynamic auditory environment, we revealed a distinct chronological hierarchy governing predictive and adaptive processing. Prior precision states - reflecting expectations - emerged earliest, followed by rapid and concurrent repetition suppression and surprisal - reflecting local acoustic attenuation and global mismatch detection. These initial dynamics culminated in subsequent, distributed model updates within fronto-parietal networks. Spectrally, these components mapped onto diverging oscillatory fingerprints, ranging from theta-alpha modulation during adaptation to beta suppression during surprisal and broad spectral dampening during precision weighting. Together, these findings demonstrate that the brain navigates uncertain auditory environments through a cascade of neural processes, where fast, local sensory gating and mismatch signals precede the hierarchical revision of internal models.
papers.translated_summary: 听觉感知产生于输入声学信号与统计预测的持续整合过程，这一过程由更简单的局部适应加以补充。然而，这些并行机制如何在时间中展开仍研究不足。我们利用脑磁图（MEG）记录参与者聆听具有周期性变化的推断统计特性的随机音调序列，对刺激特异性重复抑制、惊奇度、模型更新和先验精度的时空与频谱动态进行了建模。通过在这一动态听觉环境中同时追踪这些计算参数，我们揭示了支配预测性与适应性加工的一个独特的时间层级结构。反映期望的先验精度状态最早出现，随后是快速且并发的重复抑制与惊奇度——分别反映局部声学衰减和全局失配检测。这些初始动态最终汇聚为额顶网络中随后的分布式模型更新。在频谱上，这些成分映射到不同的振荡特征，从适应过程中的θ-α调制，到惊奇度期间的β抑制，以及精度加权期间的广泛频谱衰减。总之，这些发现表明，大脑通过一系列神经过程在不确定的听觉环境中导航，其中快速的局部感觉门控和失配信号先于内部模型的层级化修正。

papers.title: Ranging and territoriality in African Apes
papers.translated_title: 非洲猿类的活动范围与领域性
papers.author: Surbeck, M.
papers.summary: Intergroup relations vary strikingly among African apes, with only chimpanzees showing intense, often lethal territoriality. The economic defendability hypothesis proposes that such territorial behaviour is favored where home ranges can be economically defended, as indexed by the ratio of daily travel distance to home range diameter. To test this idea, we compiled and analyzed comparable data on yearly home range size, daily travel distance and defendability indices from one population of each nonhuman African ape species and integrated these with comparable published data. We find that bonobos had substantially larger home ranges and longer daily travel distances than chimpanzees and gorillas, contradicting a prevailing assumption that bonobos experience higher or more reliable food abundance. Defendability indices were higher in chimpanzees and bonobos than in mountain gorillas, but did not differ significantly between chimpanzees, bonobos, and western gorillas. Overall, our results indicate that economic defendability alone cannot explain interspecific variation in territoriality and that our current understanding of ecological differences between the species of the genus Pan have to be revised. Possible additional factors shaping space use of neighboring groups include mate competition within groups.
papers.translated_summary: 非洲猿类之间的群体间关系差异显著，只有黑猩猩表现出强烈的、往往致命的领域性。经济可防卫性假说提出，这种行为在家园范围可以被经济地防卫时受到青睐，其指标为每日移动距离与家园范围直径之比。为检验这一观点，我们汇编并分析了每种非人类非洲猿类各一个种群的年度家园范围大小、每日移动距离和可防卫性指数的可比数据，并将这些数据与已发表的可比数据整合。我们发现，倭黑猩猩的家园范围显著大于黑猩猩和大猩猩，每日移动距离也更长，这与倭黑猩猩食物丰度更高或更稳定的主流假设相矛盾。黑猩猩和倭黑猩猩的可防卫性指数高于山地大猩猩，但黑猩猩、倭黑猩猩和西部大猩猩之间无显著差异。总体而言，我们的结果表明，仅凭经济可防卫性无法解释领域性的种间变异，且我们目前对Pan属各种之间生态差异的理解必须修正。塑造邻近群体空间利用的可能额外因素包括群体内的配偶竞争。

papers.title: Structural Basis for Human Milk Oligosaccharides Recognition by Evolutionarily Dominant Norovirus Genogroup II Genotypes
papers.translated_title: 人乳寡糖被进化优势诺如病毒基因群II基因型识别的结构基础
papers.author: Pisapia, L.
papers.summary: Human noroviruses are a major cause of acute gastroenteritis. Human milk oligosaccharides (HMOs) contain glycan motifs similar to histo-blood group antigens and may act as soluble decoys that reduce viral attachment. However, the molecular basis of HMO recognition by the P domain of the major capsid protein VP1 of different norovirus genotypes is not fully understood. Here, we combined ligand-based and protein-based NMR experiments with X-ray crystallography to study HMO binding to the P domain of the latent GII.2, dominant GII.4 and emerging GII.17 noroviruses genotypes. Screening of 12 HMOs by STD NMR showed binding of all fucosylated HMOs to GII.4 and GII.17 and none for non-fucosylated HMOs. In contrast, GII.2 showed little or no detectable binding under the same conditions. Seven crystal structures of GII.4 or GII.17 with complexed HMOs supported fucose anchoring via five conserved residues. The remaining sugar moieties formed genotype-specific secondary interactions with an extended, shallow and solvent exposed binding surface whose shape is dictated by divergent surface loops. GII.4 recognition is mainly driven by hydrogen bonds whereas GII.17 relied more strongly on water-mediated interactions. Chemical shift perturbation from NMR titrations (CSP NMR) of GII.4 corroborated the fucose interactions and gave dissociation constants of 20-33 mM, consistent with weak and rapidly exchanging interactions.
papers.translated_summary: 人诺如病毒是急性胃肠炎的主要病因。人乳寡糖（HMOs）含有与组织血型抗原相似的糖基基序，可能作为可溶性诱饵减少病毒附着。然而，不同诺如病毒基因型主要衣壳蛋白VP1的P结构域识别HMO的分子基础尚未完全阐明。在此，我们结合基于配体和基于蛋白质的NMR实验与X射线晶体学，研究了HMO与潜伏型GII.2、优势型GII.4和新出现GII.17诺如病毒基因型P结构域的结合。通过STD NMR对12种HMO的筛选显示，所有岩藻糖基化HMO均与GII.4和GII.17结合，而非岩藻糖基化HMO均不结合。相比之下，GII.2在相同条件下显示很少或检测不到结合。GII.4或GII.17与HMO复合的七个晶体结构支持岩藻糖通过五个保守残基进行锚定。其余糖基部分与延伸的、浅的且溶剂暴露的结合表面形成基因型特异性的次级相互作用，该表面的形状由不同的表面环决定。GII.4的识别主要由氢键驱动，而GII.17更强烈地依赖水介导的相互作用。GII.4的NMR滴定化学位移扰动（CSP NMR）证实了岩藻糖相互作用，并给出20-33 mM的解离常数，与弱且快速交换的相互作用一致。

papers.title: PREMISE: A Quality-Aware Probabilistic Framework for High-Resolution Source Assignment in Metagenomic Sequencing
papers.translated_title: 前提：一种用于宏基因组测序中高分辨率来源分配的质量感知概率框架
papers.author: Vijendran, S.
papers.summary: Metagenomic applications, from influenza A virus (IAV) subtype tracking to bacterial strain resolution, frequently require sub-species resolution.However, traditional $k$-mer-based methods fragment reads into short $k$-mers and discard per-base quality scores.By omitting both intra-read linkage and error information, these methods confound closely related genomic variants, thereby impeding real-time pathogen surveillance and containment.We introduce \premise (Pathogen Resolution via Expectation-Maximization In Sequencing Experiments), a probabilistic, alignment-based framework implemented in Rust for high-resolution source assignment against near-complete reference databases.\premise aligns whole reads using a bidirectional run-length FM-index and quantifies reference abundances with a quality-aware Expectation-Maximization algorithm mapped over a taxonomy.This framework applies an optional sparsity penalty to resolve ambiguous assignments, which is particularly important when sparse samples are mapped against reference databases rich in highly homologous candidate references.On ten dense CAMI II strain-madness samples, \premise achieves the highest species-level read classification F1 score ($0.992$) among eight evaluated methods, with no false-positive or missed species.At the strain level, \premise maps reads to their source genome with top precision ($0.80$ vs. at most $0.64$ for competing methods), achieves 100\% recall, and estimates abundances as accurately as the best competing tool.These results demonstrate \premise's ability to provide rigorous, uncertainty-aware source resolution across both dense and sparse metagenomes, accurately resolving targets ranging from viral subtypes to bacterial strains.\\textbf{Availability:} \url{https://github.com/sriram98v/premise} under an MIT license.\\textbf{Contact:} \href{sriramv@iastate.edu}{sriramv@iastate.edu}\\
papers.translated_summary: 宏基因组应用，从甲型流感病毒（IAV）亚型追踪到细菌菌株解析，经常需要亚种分辨率。然而，传统的基于$k$-mer的方法将reads片段化为短的$k$-mer并丢弃逐碱基质量分数。通过同时忽略read内连锁和错误信息，这些方法混淆了密切相关的基因组变异，从而阻碍了实时病原体监测和遏制。我们引入\premise（通过测序实验中的期望最大化进行病原体解析），这是一个用Rust实现的基于比对的概率框架，用于针对近乎完整的参考数据库进行高分辨率来源分配。\premise使用双向游程FM索引比对整个reads，并通过映射到分类学上的质量感知期望最大化算法量化参考丰度。该框架应用可选的稀疏性惩罚来解决模糊分配，这在稀疏样本映射到富含高度同源候选参考的参考数据库时尤为重要。在十个密集的CAMI II菌株疯狂样本上，\premise在八种评估方法中实现了最高的物种级read分类F1分数（$0.992$），没有假阳性或遗漏物种。在菌株水平上，\premise将reads映射到其来源基因组，具有最高精确度（$0.80$，而竞争方法至多为$0.64$），实现100\%召回率，并且丰度估计与最佳竞争工具一样准确。这些结果证明了\premise在密集和稀疏宏基因组中提供严格的、不确定性感知的来源解析的能力，准确解析从病毒亚型到细菌菌株的目标。\\textbf{可用性：} \url{https://github.com/sriram98v/premise}，MIT许可证。\\textbf{联系方式：} \href{sriramv@iastate.edu}{sriramv@iastate.edu}\\

papers.title: Mathematical model of phenotypic plasticity predicts interconversion is a drug target for neuroblastoma.
papers.translated_title: 表型可塑性的数学模型预测相互转化是神经母细胞瘤的药物靶点。
papers.author: Covell, F.
papers.summary: Neuroblastoma is a paediatric cancer arising from the sympathetic nervous system as neural crest cells, made up of noradrenergic (NOR/ADRN/N), mesenchymal like (MES/S), and intermediate (I-type/I) cell types. These cells can interconvert between types, contributing to treatment resistance and relapse. We developed a mathematical model to investigate how interconversion patterns affect the efficacy of phenotype-specific inhibitors. We used three ordinary differential equations to describe the dynamics of the three populations, including logistic growth, interconversion, and drug-induced death. Of the 64 possible interconversion patterns, five reduced the target population: two for N cells and three for S cells. N targeting patterns were more effective with higher interconversion rates, while mesenchymal targeting patterns were more effective with lower interconversion rates. Stability analysis revealed that natural tumour growth was always unstable, but during treatment, N-suppressing patterns combined with an S inhibitor gave the most consistently stable origin. Testing multi-stage and cyclic treatment schedules revealed that N-suppressing patterns with an S inhibitor, followed by an S-suppressing pattern with an N inhibitor, achieved more reliable remission. Three of the five patterns of interest correspond to reported biological plausibility, and known compounds exist to induce most of the required transitions, supporting the clinical relevance of these strategies for improving neuroblastoma treatment outcomes.
papers.translated_summary: 神经母细胞瘤是一种起源于交感神经系统的儿童癌症，由神经嵴细胞发展而来，包含去甲肾上腺素能（NOR/ADRN/N）、间充质样（MES/S）和中间型（I-type/I）细胞类型。这些细胞类型之间可以相互转化，从而导致治疗耐药和复发。我们建立了一个数学模型来研究相互转化模式如何影响表型特异性抑制剂的疗效。我们使用三个常微分方程来描述三种细胞群体的动态变化，包括逻辑斯谛生长、相互转化和药物诱导的死亡。在64种可能的相互转化模式中，有五种模式能够减少目标细胞群体：两种针对N细胞，三种针对S细胞。靶向N细胞的模式在相互转化率较高时更为有效，而靶向间充质细胞的模式在相互转化率较低时更为有效。稳定性分析揭示，自然肿瘤生长始终是不稳定的，但在治疗过程中，抑制N细胞的模式联合S细胞抑制剂能够给出最为持续稳定的原点。测试多阶段和循环治疗方案显示，先使用抑制N细胞的模式联合S细胞抑制剂，再使用抑制S细胞的模式联合N细胞抑制剂，能够实现更可靠的缓解。五种关注模式中有三种与已报道的生物学合理性相符，且已有已知化合物能够诱导大多数所需的转化，这支持了这些策略在改善神经母细胞瘤治疗预后方面的临床相关性。

papers.title: Residual Hearing Loss After Chronic Cochlear Implantation in Guinea Pigs is Primarily Conductive
papers.translated_title: 豚鼠长期人工耳蜗植入后的残余听力损失主要为传导性
papers.author: He, W.
papers.summary: It is desirous to preserve residual low-frequency hearing in cochlear implant recipients, as dual stimulation using electrical and acoustic signals results in superior speech-in-noise processing and musicality. However, cochlear implant recipients commonly lose their residual acoustic hearing gradually following surgical placement of the array. The governing mechanism is not understood and is likely due to multiple factors including surgical trauma, inflammation, and the foreign body induced immune response to the array, including formation of intracochlear fibrosis. Normal mechanical function of the cochlea is expected to underpin residual hearing but has not been directly studied. This function includes efficient transmission of sound to the cochlea via the middle ear, sound propagation via the basilar membrane travelling wave, mechanical tuning characteristics, and the non-linear cochlear amplification of responses to low-frequency stimulation. Here, we examined these features in cochleae and middle ears of unimplanted, acutely and chronically implanted guinea pigs using our minimally invasive preparation and optical coherence tomography vibrometry. We observed that mechanical tuning and amplification is not significantly altered by either acute or chronic implant. However, the response threshold was raised and proportional to middle ear responses. Additionally, the organ of Corti phase, and its sound intensity dependent changes, are unaltered by CI. Finally, a cluster analysis revealed sensitivity loss in chronically implanted animals is caused by middle ear dysfunction. Hence, in the guinea pig model, the dominant etiology of residual hearing loss is conductive. More research is required to establish whether residual hearing loss in humans similarly shares conductive elements.
papers.translated_summary: 在耳蜗植入者中保留残余低频听力是可取的，因为电声联合刺激能够带来更优的噪声中言语处理能力和音乐感知能力。然而，耳蜗植入者在阵列手术放置后通常会逐渐丧失其残余声学听力。其主导机制尚不清楚，可能由多种因素导致，包括手术创伤、炎症以及对阵列的外来异物诱导免疫反应，其中包括耳蜗内纤维化的形成。耳蜗的正常机械功能被认为是残余听力的基础，但尚未被直接研究。该功能包括声音通过中耳高效传递至耳蜗、通过基底膜行波进行声音传播、机械调谐特性，以及对低频刺激响应的非线性耳蜗放大。在此，我们使用微创制备和光学相干断层扫描振动测量技术，检查了未植入、急性和慢性植入豚鼠的耳蜗和中耳的这些特征。我们观察到，机械调谐和放大并未因急性或慢性植入而发生显著改变。然而，响应阈值升高，且与中耳响应成比例。此外，Corti器相位及其随声强变化的情况未受CI影响。最后，聚类分析显示，慢性植入动物的敏感性损失由中耳功能障碍引起。因此，在豚鼠模型中，残余听力损失的主导病因是传导性的。需要更多研究来确定人类的残余听力损失是否同样具有传导性成分。

papers.title: β-cell NCK1 is reduced in type 2 diabetes, impairing the unfolded protein response and insulin secretion while revealing sex-specific adaptation
papers.translated_title: 2型糖尿病中β细胞NCK1减少，损害未折叠蛋白反应和胰岛素分泌，同时揭示性别特异性适应
papers.author: Monteillet, L.
papers.summary: Type 2 diabetes is characterized by failure of pancreatic {beta} cells to adapt insulin secretion to metabolic demand, causing {beta} cell function and reduced {beta} cell mass. The unfolded protein response (UPR) is central to adaptation by maintaining endoplasmic reticulum homeostasis and supporting insulin biosynthesis, secretion, proliferation, and survival. NCK1, is an adaptor protein that regulates insulin biosynthesis and UPR activation, positioning it at the crossroads of several processes essential for {beta} cell function. We found in mouse and human islets that NCK1 expression was upregulated by glucose and reduced in individuals living with type 2 diabetes. We thus explored the importance of {beta} cell NCK1 in endocrine function and glucose homeostasis using INS 1 cells, mouse and human islets, and {beta} cell specific knockout male and female mice (NCK1{beta}KO). Loss of {beta} cell NCK1 disrupted the UPR and impaired insulin gene expression, insulin content, and glucose stimulated insulin secretion in vitro. Unexpectedly, these intrinsic {beta} cell defects triggered sex-specific adaptive responses at the organismal level, revealing distinct strategies to reshape glucose homeostasis. Under high fat/high sucrose diet, both NCK1{beta}KO female and male mice increased pancreatic insulin content, but females exhibited impaired insulin secretion associated with an increased number of small islets and reduced PERK pathway activation resulting in mild glucose intolerance. In contrast, males NCK1{beta}KO mice had improved insulin secretion associated with islet expansion, {beta} cell proliferation, and increased PERK pathway activation leading to enhanced glucose tolerance. These findings identify NCK1 as a regulator of {beta} cell insulin synthesis, secretion, and UPR signaling, and reveal sex specific adaptive mechanisms to metabolic stress. Thus, reduced NCK1 in islets from people living type 2 diabetes may contribute to {beta} cell dysfunction.
papers.translated_summary: 2型糖尿病的特征是胰腺β细胞无法使胰岛素分泌适应代谢需求，导致β细胞功能受损和β细胞质量减少。未折叠蛋白反应（UPR）通过维持内质网稳态和支持胰岛素生物合成、分泌、增殖及存活，在适应过程中发挥核心作用。NCK1是一种调节胰岛素生物合成和UPR激活的衔接蛋白，使其处于β细胞功能所必需的多个过程的交汇点。我们在小鼠和人类胰岛中发现，NCK1表达受葡萄糖上调，而在2型糖尿病患者中降低。因此，我们利用INS 1细胞、小鼠和人类胰岛以及β细胞特异性敲除雄性和雌性小鼠（NCK1βKO），探讨了β细胞NCK1在内分泌功能和葡萄糖稳态中的重要性。β细胞NCK1缺失破坏了UPR，并在体外损害了胰岛素基因表达、胰岛素含量和葡萄糖刺激的胰岛素分泌。出乎意料的是，这些β细胞内在缺陷在机体水平触发了性别特异性的适应性反应，揭示了重塑葡萄糖稳态的不同策略。在高脂/高蔗糖饮食下，NCK1βKO雌性和雄性小鼠均增加了胰腺胰岛素含量，但雌性表现出胰岛素分泌受损，伴有小胰岛数量增加和PERK通路激活减少，导致轻度葡萄糖不耐受。相反，雄性NCK1βKO小鼠表现出胰岛素分泌改善，伴有胰岛扩增、β细胞增殖和PERK通路激活增加，导致葡萄糖耐量增强。这些发现确定NCK1是β细胞胰岛素合成、分泌和UPR信号传导的调节因子，并揭示了应对代谢应激的性别特异性适应机制。因此，2型糖尿病患者胰岛中NCK1减少可能促进β细胞功能障碍。

papers.title: Secondary growth in the tomato stem is suppressed by the flowering regulators FUL2 and STM3
papers.translated_title: 番茄茎的次生生长受到开花调控因子FUL2和STM3的抑制
papers.author: Pandey, K.
papers.summary: Herbaceous eudicot crops such as tomato accumulate substantial amounts of secondary xylem in their stems, particularly in the basal part. As plants progress from the vegetative phase to flowering and fruit development, secondary growth continues to provide mechanical support and facilitate transport. To uncover how secondary growth is regulated in the tomato stem, we used laser capture microdissection RNA-seq to establish tissue-specific transcriptomic profiles. This revealed that key regulators associated with wood formation in poplar are also acting in tomato. Furthermore, we found that the flowering regulators FUL2 and STM3 are substantially expressed in xylem tissue. Subsequent functional analysis identified FUL2 and STM3 as key repressors of secondary growth, with ful2 or stm3 knock-out mutants exhibiting strongly increased secondary growth in older tomato stems. Notably, a higher order mutant in which both ful2 and stm3 were knocked out displays a similar non-additive phenotype, indicating, together with yeast two-hybrid data showing physical interaction, that FUL2 and STM3 act together in a complex. The expression levels of both genes remain low until after the floral transition but strongly rise during subsequent stem development. Transcriptomic analyses in ful2, stm3, and wild-type stems at stages before and after detectable anatomical differences, showed that the FUL2-STM3 complex represses distinct sets of NAC and MYB candidate regulators associated with xylem development. Interestingly, FUL2 and STM3 control these regulators in a stage- and position-dependent way, with candidates showing upregulation only at later stages in mid-height stems being already upregulated at earlier stages in basal stem regions. Our findings provide a tissue-resolved transcriptomic resource for tomato stems and reveal a role for FUL2 and STM3 in limiting secondary xylem accumulation as stem development progresses.
papers.translated_summary: 草本真双子叶作物如番茄在其茎中，尤其是基部，积累大量次生木质部。随着植物从营养阶段向开花和果实发育阶段推进，次生生长持续提供机械支撑并促进运输。为了揭示番茄茎中次生生长是如何被调控的，我们利用激光捕获显微切割RNA-seq建立了组织特异性转录组图谱。这揭示了与杨树木材形成相关的关键调控因子在番茄中也有作用。此外，我们发现开花调控因子FUL2和STM3在木质部组织中大量表达。随后的功能分析鉴定出FUL2和STM3是次生生长的关键抑制因子，ful2或stm3敲除突变体在较老番茄茎中表现出强烈增加的次生生长。值得注意的是，同时敲除ful2和stm3的高阶突变体显示出类似的非加性表型，结合酵母双杂交数据显示的物理相互作用，表明FUL2和STM3在一个复合体中共同作用。这两个基因的表达水平在花转变之前一直保持较低，但在随后的茎发育过程中强烈上升。在可检测到解剖学差异之前和之后阶段对ful2、stm3和野生型茎的转录组分析表明，FUL2-STM3复合体抑制与木质部发育相关的不同NAC和MYB候选调控因子集。有趣的是，FUL2和STM3以阶段和位置依赖的方式控制这些调控因子，仅在中高茎的后期阶段上调的候选因子在基部茎区的早期阶段就已经上调。我们的发现为番茄茎提供了组织分辨的转录组资源，并揭示了FUL2和STM3在茎发育进程中限制次生木质部积累的作用。

papers.title: A three-factor model can explain symmetry breaking and the n-1 rule during X-chromosome inactivation
papers.translated_title: 三因子模型可以解释X染色体失活过程中的对称性破缺和n-1规则
papers.author: Guan, K.
papers.summary: X-chromosome inactivation (XCI) is a mammalian gene regulatory process that via chromosome-scale transcriptional silencing, leaves active a single X chromosome per diploid genome complement. The mechanisms that enable cells to select the appropriate number of X chromosomes to inactivate while leaving others active remain unclear. We demonstrate that all known chromosomal counting scenarios during XCI can be accounted for by a three-factor mathematical model that includes (1) Xist, the long noncoding RNA (lncRNA) responsible for gene silencing during XCI in eutherians, (2) an X-linked transcriptional activator of Xist, and (3) the autosomally-encoded SPEN, an Xist RNA-binding protein that is essential for gene silencing during XCI. In our model, symmetry between active X chromosomes is broken by stochastic differences in the number of Xist molecules that associate with the X chromosomes at the onset of XCI. Subsequently, integrated positive and negative feedback loops amplify then propagate superstoichiometric assemblies of SPEN complexed with Xist on the inactive chromosome(s), and select for levels of X-linked activator that enable only one X chromosome per diploid genome complement to remain active. Thus, asymmetric propagation of the SPEN-Xist ribonucleoprotein complex may play an essential role in symmetry breaking and chromosomal counting during XCI, independently of or in concert with cis-acting networks of DNA regulatory elements. Our results also have conceptual implications for gene regulatory circuits on autosomes.
papers.translated_summary: X染色体失活（XCI）是一种哺乳动物基因调控过程，通过染色体规模的转录沉默，使二倍体基因组补体中仅保留一条X染色体处于活跃状态。细胞如何在失活适当数量的X染色体的同时保持其他X染色体活跃的机制仍不清楚。我们证明，XCI过程中所有已知的染色体计数情景均可由一个三因子数学模型解释，该模型包括：（1）Xist，即真兽类XCI过程中负责基因沉默的长非编码RNA（lncRNA）；（2）Xist的X连锁转录激活因子；（3）常染色体编码的SPEN，一种Xist RNA结合蛋白，对XCI过程中的基因沉默至关重要。在我们的模型中，活跃X染色体之间的对称性被XCI起始时与X染色体结合的Xist分子数量的随机差异所打破。随后，整合的正负反馈环路放大并传播失活染色体上SPEN与Xist复合形成的超化学计量组装体，并筛选X连锁激活因子的水平，使得每个二倍体基因组补体中仅有一条X染色体保持活跃。因此，SPEN-Xist核糖核蛋白复合体的不对称传播可能在XCI过程中的对称性打破和染色体计数中发挥重要作用，其作用独立于或协同于DNA调控元件的顺式作用网络。我们的结果对常染色体上的基因调控回路也具有概念性意义。

papers.title: Auditory Evoked Potentials Differ from Controls and Correlate with Aspects of Cognition in Kabuki Syndrome and Rubinstein-Taybi Syndrome
papers.translated_title: 听觉诱发电位在歌舞伎综合征和鲁宾斯坦-泰比综合征中与对照组不同，并与认知的某些方面相关
papers.author: Kalinousky, A.
papers.summary: Objective Kabuki syndrome (KS) and Rubinstein-Taybi syndrome (RSTS) are two disorders caused by dysfunctional components of the epigenetic machinery and both result in intellectual disability. Mouse models of both KS and RSTS have seen reversal of cognitive impairment with epigenetic treatments. However, a great need exists for biomarkers in these disorders to improve the likelihood of successful clinical trials. This study aimed to investigate cortical auditory evoked potentials (AEPs) in KS and RSTS so that it could potentially be developed into a response biomarker in the future. Methods The amplitude of the N1-P2-N2 complex was measured for passive listening to monotonal auditory stimuli in individuals with KS, with RSTS, and typically developing controls. A standardized cognitive assessment battery was performed and specific subtests were correlated with AEP values. Results Groups differed significantly in P2, N2, and P2-N2 amplitude although RSTS was consistently more different from typically developing controls than was KS. The mid- to late-phase AEP components (P2 and N2) also correlate with cognition within and across these groups particularly with language whereas earlier components N1 and P2 correlate more with measures of executive functioning. Conclusion Late-phase components of AEPs differ in KS and RSTS from each other and from controls. KS and RSTS differ from controls in P2 and N2 amplitude in the same direction and both show a positive correlation between language and P2 amplitude and a negative correlation between language and N2 amplitude. Together they also show an association with N1 and P2 amplitude and executive functioning. Significance AEPs may turn out to be a valuable response biomarker in KS and RSTS individually and together.
papers.translated_summary: 目的 Kabuki综合征（KS）和Rubinstein-Taybi综合征（RSTS）是由表观遗传机制组分功能障碍引起的两种疾病，均可导致智力障碍。KS和RSTS的小鼠模型已通过表观遗传治疗实现认知障碍的逆转。然而，这些疾病亟需生物标志物以提高临床试验成功的可能性。本研究旨在探究KS和RSTS患者的皮层听觉诱发电位（AEPs），以期未来将其开发为反应生物标志物。方法 测量KS患者、RSTS患者及典型发育对照组在被动聆听单音听觉刺激时的N1-P2-N2复合波幅。进行标准化认知评估 battery，并将特定分测验与AEP值进行相关性分析。结果 各组在P2、N2及P2-N2波幅上存在显著差异，其中RSTS与典型发育对照组的差异始终大于KS。中晚期AEP成分（P2和N2）在这些组内及组间均与认知相关，尤其是与语言相关，而早期成分N1和P2则更多与执行功能测量相关。结论 KS和RSTS的晚期AEP成分彼此不同，且均与对照组不同。KS和RSTS在P2和N2波幅上与对照组差异方向相同，且两者均显示语言与P2波幅呈正相关、语言与N2波幅呈负相关。两者合并分析还显示与N1和P2波幅及执行功能存在关联。意义 AEPs可能成为KS和RSTS单独及联合应用中有价值的反应生物标志物。
